scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @nimbox/preferences && npm run build --workspace @nimbox/preferences-react
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @nimbox/preferences && npm run typecheck --workspace @nimbox/preferences-react
scripts.preversion: npm ci && npm run build && npm run porcelain
scripts.postversion: git commit -m "$npm_package_version" && git tag "v$npm_package_version" && git push origin main && git push origin "v$npm_package_version"
